findings.text: Independent Opus review clean PASS, 0 blocking: three mutations each turned the selftest red (never resume on an answer -> the blocked run stays blocked; ignore abort -> the loop runs both steps and completes; drop ack so a command double-processes). Cooperative-only confirmed by grepping the diff for signal/kill/terminate (none in code); exactly-once ack confirmed (os.replace + False on re-ack + ordinals never reused).

summary: R5 (WARP-0505, answer/steer/abort) is correct and honest. Independent adversarial review clean PASS, 0 blocking; gate GREEN (selftest 840). A human unblocks or stops a running build cooperatively through the run inbox: an answer resumes a blocked run, an abort finishes it aborted at the next safe checkpoint (never mid-step), a steer is recorded for the agent; commands are processed exactly once and nothing external preempts the process. The requirement-change-must-commit rule is a documented procedure. Three mutations proven to turn the selftest red. run_interaction mechanical is honest. proof_digest via validate.py.
